d:
Keral men 17 sal ki ek larki ki kidni ki bimari ke bad ek feyarnes krim braind ke khilaf mamla darj kiya gaya hai.
Aspatal ke mutabiq, krim men para yani marakri ki matra tay sima se kahin zyada mili.
Aakhir feyarnes krim men pare ka istemal kyon kiya jata hai aur yah tvacha ke raste kidni ko kaise nuksan pahuncha sakta hai? eksaparts se samjhie.
Riport: guraprit saini
Editing: sumit vaidy
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
